question_answered: Are waveform vectors decoded into the physically correct channel/sample frame?
required_inputs: raw vector length; header sample count; channel count
pass_condition: One stable vector length and exact agreement with header and configured shape
red_flag: Multiple lengths or configured shape differs from header
interpretation_if_red: Stop: all downstream channel waveforms may be desynchronised

question_answered: Are immutable input hashes and every calibration/map status recorded?
required_inputs: file hashes; config blob hashes; status fields
pass_condition: All inputs source-bound and no consumed object is retracted
red_flag: Missing hash or RETRACTED status
interpretation_if_red: Stop: no physical timing claim is authorized

question_answered: Do B2/B4/B6/B8 show real pulse morphology rather than pedestal boundaries?
required_inputs: random raw waveforms per channel
pass_condition: Localized pulse with stable polarity and plausible leading edge
red_flag: Step at a fixed channel-boundary sample or quiet pedestal channel
interpretation_if_red: The timed object is likely a decode/pedestal artifact

question_answered: Is the pretrigger baseline uncontaminated and stable?
required_inputs: pretrigger samples per event and channel
pass_condition: Centered residuals; stationary RMS; negligible slope
red_flag: Multimodal baseline; drift; pulse in baseline window
interpretation_if_red: Baseline subtraction biases amplitude and crossing time

question_answered: Is the component used for timing the same component that passes the amplitude cut?
required_inputs: global and selected peak index/amplitude
pass_condition: Selected/global amplitude near one or independently validated component identity
red_flag: Tiny early component selected while later global peak passes cut
interpretation_if_red: Artificially repeatable early crossings can create a narrow core

question_answered: Are accepted pulses inside the acquisition window with one physical timing mode?
required_inputs: amplitude and peak index per stave
pass_condition: Single in-window mode away from boundaries
red_flag: Boundary peaks or multimodal/discrete bands
interpretation_if_red: Trigger-phase or truncation dominates timing

question_answered: Does interpolation use the intended rising edge with adequate slope?
required_inputs: waveform; threshold; bracketing samples; selected peak
pass_condition: One bracket before selected peak and positive stable slope
red_flag: Crossing at sample 0; flat denominator; wrong pulse; threshold recrossing
interpretation_if_red: Timestamp is undefined or component-ambiguous

question_answered: Where are events lost and are rows distinguished from physical events?
required_inputs: unique event keys and selection masks
pass_condition: Counts are unique events and every rejection has a named reason
red_flag: Waveform rows called events; hidden pair-lock loss
interpretation_if_red: Quoted statistical precision and efficiency are wrong

question_answered: Do timestamps occupy physically plausible windows without boundary piles?
required_inputs: accepted t_i by stave
pass_condition: Interior continuous distribution with stable modes
red_flag: Spikes at window edges or integer sample locations
interpretation_if_red: Timing estimator is quantized/truncated or component-switching

plot_title: t_i versus t_j and sample-index map
question_answered: Is the narrow residual caused by genuine correlated arrival times or a common artifact?
required_inputs: paired timestamps and peak/crossing indices
pass_condition: Diagonal physical correlation that persists across run/amplitude strata
red_flag: Fixed sample-offset lattice or pedestal-step correlation
interpretation_if_red: Common-mode decode/phase structure is cancelling in the difference

question_answered: Which operation changes the median and which changes the width?
required_inputs: raw difference; TOF; offset; timewalk; phase corrections
pass_condition: Constant TOF/offset changes only location; trained corrections improve held-out width
red_flag: A constant shift changes width or same events are not preserved
interpretation_if_red: Bookkeeping/event selection changed between stages

plot_title: Residual histogram linear and log scale
question_answered: Is one width sufficient to describe the distribution?
required_inputs: full residual vector
pass_condition: Core width RMS and tail fractions jointly reported
red_flag: RMS much larger than sigma68 or visible secondary modes
interpretation_if_red: Do not call a narrow core detector resolution

question_answered: Is the Gaussian model statistically adequate?
required_inputs: fit model; bin counts; residuals
pass_condition: Reasonable pulls and chi2/ndf order one
red_flag: chi2/ndf much greater than one or tail QQ departure
interpretation_if_red: Gaussian sigma is a descriptive core parameter only

plot_title: Residual versus A_i A_j and amplitude ratio
question_answered: Does residual depend on signal size and is correction held out?
required_inputs: amplitudes and residuals by train/test run
pass_condition: Slope consistent with zero on held-out runs after correction
red_flag: Residual trend or correction trained/evaluated on same events
interpretation_if_red: Quoted resolution contains timewalk or selection overfitting

plot_title: Residual versus crossing slope and baseline noise
question_answered: Does observed precision follow jitter approximately noise/slope?
required_inputs: crossing slope; baseline RMS; residual
pass_condition: A smooth physically plausible improvement with slope
red_flag: Ultra-narrow band independent of SNR/slope
interpretation_if_red: Timestamp may be driven by a deterministic digital artifact

plot_title: Residual versus sub-sample phase and peak-sample pair
question_answered: Is interpolation calibrated across the whole sampling cell?
required_inputs: fractional crossing phase; sample indices
pass_condition: No phase-dependent bias/width after calibration
red_flag: Sawtooth bias or narrow result confined to one phase bin
interpretation_if_red: Sub-sample interpolation is not globally calibrated

question_answered: Is the headline stable across independent data blocks?
required_inputs: run and event block IDs
pass_condition: Compatible medians and widths with block-bootstrap intervals
red_flag: One run/block dominates or large drifts
interpretation_if_red: Headline is not portable and IID bootstrap undercovers

plot_title: CFD fraction scan with held-out selection
question_answered: Was the fraction chosen without test-set optimization?
required_inputs: train/validation/test run split
pass_condition: Choose on training/validation then quote untouched test result
red_flag: Minimum chosen and reported on same events
interpretation_if_red: Look-elsewhere/overfitting bias narrows the result

question_answered: Is there enough independent information to solve stave terms?
required_inputs: three or more connected staves or external reference
pass_condition: Every pair measured with compatible selection and covariance diagnostics
red_flag: Only one pair or disconnected graph
interpretation_if_red: Individual stave resolutions are underdetermined

question_answered: Does the inferred stave model reproduce every pair and injected truth?
required_inputs: pair variances; covariance model; MC/injection truth
pass_condition: Non-negative solution; held-out pair closure; recovered injected parameters
red_flag: Negative variances; poor closure; strong model sensitivity
interpretation_if_red: Report pair residuals only; withhold intrinsic stave resolution

question_answered: How much does the result move under justified analysis variations?
required_inputs: baseline window; cuts; fraction; component selector; TOF; run split
pass_condition: All variations and correlations propagated to final interval
red_flag: Only statistical bootstrap or undocumented tuning
interpretation_if_red: Uncertainty is incomplete and performance is overstated
